answer_1.quote: We conducted experiments on 5 datasets: WebNLG, Cleaned E2E, ViGGO, a Conversational Weather dataset ... and an Alarm dataset ... Human evaluations were done for all test sets except WebNLG to determine acceptability, using two annotators and a tie-breaker round in case of disagreement.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluations were done for all test sets except WebNLG to determine acceptability, using two annotators and a tie-breaker round in case of disagreement.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each generated response on grammar and semantics; a response was marked Acceptable if both grammar and semantics ratings were greater than 2 (out of 3).
